▬  About Beacon Patrol  ▬▬▬▬▬
Beacon Patrol is a cooperative and relaxing tile laying exploration game. You play as captains of the Coast Guard, navigating the coast of the North Sea to secure its beacon buoys, lighthouses and waterways. Work together with your friends and score points by creating the most complete map. #cozygaming #wholesomegames #indiegame @spellgardengames

Twitter: https://twitter.com/ShapesAndDreams
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shapesanddreams/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@shapesanddreams
YouTube: @ShapesAndDreams 
Website: https://beaconpatrol.com/

▬ Assemble Entertainment ▬▬▬▬▬▬
Based in Wiesbaden, Germany, Assemble Entertainment is an independent games publisher founded by Stefan Marcinek in 2016. Known for its diverse and highly praised indie games, Assemble has published titles such as Roadwarden, Sticky Business, Lacuna, and Orbital Bullet. Their in-house studio, Gentlymad Studios, was founded in 2017 and is the developer behind the popular Pizza Connection 3 and the critically acclaimed Endzone franchise. Currently, Gentlymad Studios is developing Endzone 2, the sequel to Endzone – A World Apart. 

With a combined team of 25 dedicated employees, Assemble Entertainment continues to make significant contributions to the gaming industry. Since 2022, Assemble has also managed the distribution of Mixtvision’s games, including FAR: Lone Sails. The company has earned the German Developer Award twice in the category of “Best Publisher.” In addition to its development and publishing efforts, Assemble organizes GermanDevDays, the largest German-speaking developer conference in Germany, held annually in Frankfurt. Learn more about the GermanDevDays at https://www.germandevdays.com/ and Assemble at https://www.assembleteam.com/.  #AssembleEntertainment
